class.name: NNBTRandomSequence
class.brief_description: Executes its child nodes in a random order until either all of them succeed (returning [code]1[/code]) or one of them fails (returning [code]-1[/code]).
class.description: This node type is used to create sequences. The [NNBTRandomSequence] node executes its enabled child nodes in a random order until either all of them succeed (returning [code]1[/code]) or one of them fails (returning [code]-1[/code]). If a child returns running (0) the sequence will return running to its parent. The random order is chosen from the enabled children when a run starts and stays fixed until the run ends, so a child added or enabled during a run joins the next run. Children that are disabled when a run starts are excluded from the shuffled order. A child disabled during a run remains in the shuffled order and returns [code]FAILURE[/code] when ticked, which fails the sequence. A child that returns [code]SKIP[/code] is treated like a child that succeeded, so the sequence continues with the next child. A child removed during a run drops out of the current run and is never ticked again, even if it was the running child; the sequence then continues with the next surviving child.
